name: -8 AN Straight Female Aluminum Hose End Fitting
title: -8 AN Straight Female Aluminum Hose End Fitting
description:
The -8 AN Straight Female Aluminum Hose End Fitting is engineered for high-demand automotive fluid systems. ColorFittings Standard AN Hose Ends are precision-engineered for high-pressure fuel, oil, coolant, brake, clutch, and power steering applications. Designed for use with nylon or stainless steel braided hose, these AN fittings provide a secure, leak-free 37-degree flare seal for street performance, racing, marine, and motorsport plumbing systems.

Each hose end is CNC-machined from aerospace-grade 6061-T6 billet aluminum and finished with ColorFittings' proprietary polishing and anodizing process for superior strength, corrosion resistance, and long-term durability. Compatible with E85, ethanol, race fuel, pump gas, oil, coolant, brake fluid, transmission fluid, and hydraulic systems, these fittings are built to handle high-pressure, high-temperature environments.

Looking to complete your setup? Check out their full range of Standard Hose, Hose Separators, and AN Fitting Assembly Tools.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum with hard anodized protective finish.
